Microsoft (MSFT) vs Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): on the same formula, their operating margins are 36.1 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — MSFT: $331.8B · AMD: $34.6B
• Revenue growth — MSFT: +17.8% · AMD: +34.3%
• Operating margin — MSFT: 46.8% · AMD: 10.7%
• Net margin — MSFT: 40.3% · AMD: 12.5%
• Free cash flow margin — MSFT: 20.2% · AMD: 19.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — MSFT: 13.7% · AMD: 20.5%

Different fiscal years: MSFT Jun 30, 2026 · AMD Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
